placements.title: Deployment now gated on cryptographic proof of release integrity
placements.frame: What is required, exempted, or contested as the signed-manifest gate is applied across environments and releases over time?
placements.why: The gate mandate (src-1), its declarative restatement (src-3), its scope across staging and production (src-4), and its named owner (src-5) together state a standing policy — a subject future envelopes will keep feeding as the gate is enforced, extended, or exempted — passing the narrative grain test. src-2's account of two unsigned artifacts reaching staging is the one-time proof point that motivated the policy, not a theme of its own; it supports this leaf as evidence rather than minting separately, per the grain rule against making a fact its own leaf. No existing leaf structure exists yet in this repo, so this is a mint rather than a reuse.
